description: Influencer flow for up to 10 ad codes into one ad squad: for each, claim, wait for media, create creative, create a PAUSED ad. Expired codes are skipped and reported, others continue. Stops if a claimed code ends up incomplete. Claiming is one-way. Previews (format check only) unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

ref.description: Your own reference, e.g. a request id from your own tracker

name: snap_influencer_batch
